question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is** '**necessity**'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• This passage discusses the compelling force of necessity and its effects.
 
• The context of the passage suggests that necessity drives individuals to act and innovate.
 
• The analogy used ("**As order comes out of chaos**") implies that something constructive (invention) emerges from a pressing need or problem.
 
• The term "**necessity**" fits seamlessly into the narrative, underscoring the idea that invention often arises from the need to solve a particular issue or fulfill a specific requirement.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 3.'​

Correct sentence: __Necessity is an (1)** __irresistible__** force that compels a man to do things. It stirs the mind so (2) __violently__ that it causes great unrest that continues until the necessity is (3)** __fulfilled__**. As order comes out of (4)** __utter__** chaos so does an invention out of some (5) __**necessity**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option (1) - Amity** (सौहार्द) means friendship or harmony. It doesn't connect to the idea of invention arising from necessity.
 
• **Option (2) - Abstrusity** (गूढ़ता) means obscurity or difficulty to understand. It has a negative connotation and doesn't relate to the concept of invention.
